t: 怀俄明州被承认为美国第 44 个州。
te: Wyoming is admitted as the 44th U.S. state.
dz: 怀俄明州被承认为美国第 44 个州。
de: Wyoming is admitted as the 44th U.S. state.

te: Chileans led by Alejandro Gorostiaga defeat Andrés Avelino Cáceres's Peruvian army at the Battle of Huamachuco, hasteni…
dz: 太平洋之战:由亚历杭德罗·戈罗斯蒂亚加率领的智利人于花马楚克战役中击败了安德烈斯·阿韦利诺·卡塞雷斯的秘鲁军队,使战争迅速结束.
de: War of the Pacific: Chileans led by Alejandro Gorostiaga defeat Andrés Avelino Cáceres's Peruvian army at the Battle of Huamachuco, hastening the end of the war.

t: 智利在拉康塞普西翁战役中遭受了最后的军事失败,当时一支由1 300人组成的秘鲁部队消灭了由77…
te: Chile suffers its last military defeat in the Battle of La Concepción when a garrison of 77 men is annihilated by a 1,3…
dz: 太平洋战争:智利在拉康塞普西翁战役中遭受了最后的军事失败,当时一支由1 300人组成的秘鲁部队消灭了由77人组成的驻军,其中许多人配备了长矛.
de: War of the Pacific: Chile suffers its last military defeat in the Battle of La Concepción when a garrison of 77 men is annihilated by a 1,300-strong Peruvian force, many of them armed with spears.

t: 当时的波多黎各马亚圭斯的Villa正式从西班牙皇家接收其城市章程.
te: The then-villa of Mayagüez, Puerto Rico, formally receives its city charter from the Royal Crown of Spain.
dz: 当时的波多黎各马亚圭斯的Villa正式从西班牙皇家接收其城市章程.
de: The then-villa of Mayagüez, Puerto Rico, formally receives its city charter from the Royal Crown of Spain.

t: 美国总统米勒德·菲尔莫尔宣誓就职,在扎卡里·泰勒去世后成为总统的第二天.
te: U.S. President Millard Fillmore is sworn in, a day after becoming president upon Zachary Taylor's death.
dz: 美国总统米勒德·菲尔莫尔宣誓就职,在扎卡里·泰勒去世后成为总统的第二天.
de: U.S. President Millard Fillmore is sworn in, a day after becoming president upon Zachary Taylor's death.

t: 美国总统安德鲁·杰克逊否决了将重新包租美国第二银行的法案.
te: U.S. President Andrew Jackson vetoes a bill that would re-charter the Second Bank of the United States.
dz: 美国总统安德鲁·杰克逊否决了将重新包租美国第二银行的法案.
de: U.S. President Andrew Jackson vetoes a bill that would re-charter the Second Bank of the United States.

t: Vellore Mutiny是印度塞波伊人对英国东印度公司发动兵变的第一起案例.
te: The Vellore Mutiny is the first instance of a mutiny by Indian sepoys against the British East India Company.
dz: Vellore Mutiny是印度塞波伊人对英国东印度公司发动兵变的第一起案例.
de: The Vellore Mutiny is the first instance of a mutiny by Indian sepoys against the British East India Company.

t: 亚历山大·麦肯齐到达了麦肯齐河三角洲.
te: Alexander Mackenzie reaches the Mackenzie River delta.
dz: 亚历山大·麦肯齐到达了麦肯齐河三角洲.
de: Alexander Mackenzie reaches the Mackenzie River delta.

t: 法国路易十六向大不列颠王国宣战.
te: Louis XVI of France declares war on the Kingdom of Great Britain.
dz: 美国革命:法国路易十六向大不列颠王国宣战.
de: American Revolution: Louis XVI of France declares war on the Kingdom of Great Britain.

t: 盎格鲁-西班牙战争(1654–1671年):著名布克内尔·亨利·摩根(英语:Buccaneer…
te: Anglo-Spanish War (1654–1671): Notable Buccaneer Henry Morgan with an English Privateer force lands at Porto Bello in a…
dz: 盎格鲁-西班牙战争(1654–1671年):著名布克内尔·亨利·摩根(英语:Buccaneer Henry Morgan)与一支英国"私人"部队在贝洛港登陆,企图夺取坚固而有利可图的西班牙城市.
de: Anglo-Spanish War (1654–1671): Notable Buccaneer Henry Morgan with an English Privateer force lands at Porto Bello in an attempt to capture the fortified and lucrative Spanish city.

t: 英国内战:兰波特战役发生.
te: The Battle of Langport takes place.
dz: 英国内战:兰波特战役发生.
de: English Civil War: The Battle of Langport takes place.

t: 奥兰治的威廉一世被巴尔塔萨尔·盖拉德(英语:Balthasar Gérard)暗杀于他位于荷兰…
te: William I of Orange is assassinated in his home in Delft, Holland, by Balthasar Gérard.
dz: 奥兰治的威廉一世被巴尔塔萨尔·盖拉德(英语:Balthasar Gérard)暗杀于他位于荷兰德勒夫特的家中.
de: William I of Orange is assassinated in his home in Delft, Holland, by Balthasar Gérard.

t: 简·格雷夫人继承了英国王位.
te: Lady Jane Grey takes the throne of England.
dz: 简·格雷夫人继承了英国王位.
de: Lady Jane Grey takes the throne of England.

t: 朱陈豪宣布明朝正德皇帝为篡位者,起事于宁太子叛乱,并率军北上,想夺取南京.
te: Zhu Chenhao declares the Ming dynasty's Zhengde Emperor a usurper, beginning the Prince of Ning rebellion, and leads hi…
dz: 朱陈豪宣布明朝正德皇帝为篡位者,起事于宁太子叛乱,并率军北上,想夺取南京.
de: Zhu Chenhao declares the Ming dynasty's Zhengde Emperor a usurper, beginning the Prince of Ning rebellion, and leads his army north in an attempt to capture Nanjing.

t: 西班牙对伊比利亚纳瓦拉的征服始于对戈伊祖埃塔的攻克.
te: The Spanish conquest of Iberian Navarre commences with the capture of Goizueta.
dz: 西班牙对伊比利亚纳瓦拉的征服始于对戈伊祖埃塔的攻克.
de: The Spanish conquest of Iberian Navarre commences with the capture of Goizueta.

t: 葡萄牙探险家尼古拉·科埃略(Nicolau Coelho)在发现作为瓦斯科·达·加马的同伴前往…
te: The Portuguese explorer Nicolau Coelho returns to Lisbon after discovering the sea route to India as a companion of Vas…
dz: 葡萄牙探险家尼古拉·科埃略(Nicolau Coelho)在发现作为瓦斯科·达·加马的同伴前往印度的出海路线后返回了里斯本.
de: The Portuguese explorer Nicolau Coelho returns to Lisbon after discovering the sea route to India as a companion of Vasco da Gama.

t: 第16任沃里克伯爵理查德·内维尔(Richard Neville,16th Earl of W…
te: Richard Neville, 16th Earl of Warwick, defeats the king's Lancastrian forces and takes King Henry VI prisoner in the Ba…
dz: 第16任沃里克伯爵理查德·内维尔(Richard Neville,16th Earl of Warwick)在北安普敦战役中击败了国王的兰卡斯特部队并俘虏了国王亨利六世.
de: Richard Neville, 16th Earl of Warwick, defeats the king's Lancastrian forces and takes King Henry VI prisoner in the Battle of Northampton.

t: 拉迪斯劳斯四世(匈牙利语:Ladislaus IV)是匈牙利国王,被刺杀于克勒什泽克城堡(罗马…
te: Ladislaus IV, King of Hungary, is assassinated at the castle of Körösszeg (modern-day Cheresig in Romania).
dz: 拉迪斯劳斯四世(匈牙利语:Ladislaus IV)是匈牙利国王,被刺杀于克勒什泽克城堡(罗马尼亚的现代切列西格).
de: Ladislaus IV, King of Hungary, is assassinated at the castle of Körösszeg (modern-day Cheresig in Romania).

t: 伦敦几起早期火灾中最严重的一次将大部分城市烧为平地.
te: The most severe of several early fires of London burns most of the city to the ground.
dz: 伦敦几起早期火灾中最严重的一次将大部分城市烧为平地.
de: The most severe of several early fires of London burns most of the city to the ground.

t: 诺斯国王Glúniairn承认爱尔兰高级国王Máel Sechnaill mac Domnai…
te: The Norse King Glúniairn recognises Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill, High King of Ireland, and agrees to pay taxes and acce…
dz: 诺斯国王Glúniairn承认爱尔兰高级国王Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill,并同意纳税并接受Brehon法律;这一事件被认为是都柏林市的创立.
de: The Norse King Glúniairn recognises Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill, High King of Ireland, and agrees to pay taxes and accept Brehon Law; the event is considered to be the founding of the city of Dublin.

t: 皇宫政变期间，中大江亲王和藤原镰足刺杀了曾我入香。
te: Prince Naka-no-Ōe and Fujiwara no Kamatari assassinate Soga no Iruka during a coup d'état at the imperial palace.
dz: 一志事件：皇宫政变期间，中大江亲王和藤原镰足刺杀了曾我入香。
de: Isshi Incident: Prince Naka-no-Ōe and Fujiwara no Kamatari assassinate Soga no Iruka during a coup d'état at the imperial palace.

t: 阿纳斯塔修斯皇帝去世后的第二天，查士丁一世被君士坦丁堡牧首加冕为拜占庭皇帝。
te: Justin I is crowned Byzantine Emperor by the patriarch of Constantinople the day after the death of emperor Anastasius.
dz: 阿纳斯塔修斯皇帝去世后的第二天，查士丁一世被君士坦丁堡牧首加冕为拜占庭皇帝。
de: Justin I is crowned Byzantine Emperor by the patriarch of Constantinople the day after the death of emperor Anastasius.

t: 在篡夺了晋国皇帝龚相之位后,刘裕自称为刘宋王朝皇帝.
te: Having usurped the throne of Emperor Gong of Jin, Liu Yu proclaims himself Emperor of the Liu Song dynasty.
dz: 在篡夺了晋国皇帝龚相之位后,刘裕自称为刘宋王朝皇帝.
de: Having usurped the throne of Emperor Gong of Jin, Liu Yu proclaims himself Emperor of the Liu Song dynasty.

t: 罗马皇帝哈德良因心力衰竭而死于他位于那不勒斯湾(英语:Baiae)的住所;他被安葬在罗马哈德良…
te: Emperor Hadrian of Rome dies of heart failure at his residence on the bay of Naples, Baiae; he is buried at Rome in the…
dz: 罗马皇帝哈德良因心力衰竭而死于他位于那不勒斯湾(英语:Baiae)的住所;他被安葬在罗马哈德良的墓中,与他已故的妻子维比亚·萨比纳同葬.
de: Emperor Hadrian of Rome dies of heart failure at his residence on the bay of Naples, Baiae; he is buried at Rome in the Tomb of Hadrian beside his late wife, Vibia Sabina.
